findings.finding: 17 of 17 transcribed entries re-locate in the fetched PDFs (9 verbatim at entry level, 8 only as restatements: ['CSR-ULS-03', 'CSR-ULS-05', 'CSR-ULS-07', 'CSR-WAV-02', 'CSR-WAV-03', 'CSR-WAV-04', 'S7-01', 'CSR-ULS-W03']; segments: 13 verbatim, 7 normalised, 0 absent)
Table 2 gamma_S/gamma_W is the only coefficient group the anchor carries without a verbatim quote; the coordinate re-read returns verdict PASS (2 factor rows)
anchor algebra and printed numbers agree: worst relative difference 1.815e-03 (verdict PASS)
Smith M_u baseline recomputation: PASS over 2 worst-utilisation cases

the f_beta transcription condenses four printed load-case bullets (1.05 HSM/FSM, 0.8 BSR/BSP, 1.0 HSA/OST/OSA) into 'seagoing conditions'; applying the alternative values flips 2 verdict(s) at f_beta = 1.0 and 6 at f_beta = 0.8
the WITHHELD entries are conservative: 2 of them have their clause text locatable in the fetched document (sample lines recorded in withheld_probe); W26 does not transcribe them
coefficient groups whose anchor quote is a caption or model sentence only: ['W-0.19', 'U-gammaS', 'U-gammaW', 'S11-mw']; values verified against page tokens, quote field could carry the table body

limitations: the recheck verifies that printed values exist on the cited page and agree with the anchor's algebra; it does not re-derive CSR clause interpretation (e.g. which loading condition governs)
Table 1 (design load scenarios) is prose in the page text, so its rows are verified segment-wise, not by coordinates
M_u stays on the repo Smith basis; the CSR App 2 net-scantling capacity is still not exercised (CSR-ULS-W01/W02 remain WITHHELD)
only the extreme sea loads scenario (fp = fps = 1.0) is covered by the utilisation table inherited from W24
